messages:
Lina (product): quick sync — customer asks for rolling upgrades that preserve tenant egress IPs and a migration lane to a slim agent. what's the minimal spec?
Ravi (eng): main concerns: KV cache continuity and graceful drain. operator orchestration preferred for safe canaries.
Maya (netops): egress IP is non-negotiable for finance customers. Recommend customer-side NAT option + our static-relay fallback. include BGP and static-route examples.
Jill (devops): packaging: propose installer presets: full, slim, airgap. slim should set preserve_egress=true and provide post-install ip-pin check.
Lina (product): draft launch criteria: rolling upgrade without >1min p99 spike; pinned tenants keep same egress IPs; slim validated by 2 field pilots; rollback runbook.
Ravi (eng): test plan: simulate 100 tenants pinned to IPs. rollout: canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%. add /health/upgrade-ready endpoint.
Maya (netops): runbook snippets: BGP neighbor example 'neighbor 10.0.0.1 remote-as 65000', iptables fallback, validation 'curl -sS https://ifconfig.me' (note privacy).
Jill (devops): slim flags: 'installer_mode: slim', 'preserve_egress: true', 'relay_enabled: false'. I'll add --force-ip-check script.
Lina (product): estimates: operator+canary ~4 sprints (2 engs), packaging ~1 sprint, netops ~0.5 sprint + 2 weeks field validation. recommend high priority Q2.
Ravi (eng): ack, will draft PRD + canary test by Tue.
Jill (devops): prototyping ip-check tomorrow.
Maya (netops): scheduling two validation windows with field.
ship-bot: created ticket RDW-6421 assigned to Lina, Ravi, Jill, Maya.
Lina (product): thanks — i'll fold estimates into roadmap and schedule a 30-min walkthrough next Mon.
